rendered: The Low-Co/Ni-Rich Cathodes row names NMC 811[1]. In the ORNL study, that cathode kept 80%[2] capacity at 6C charging rate[3], with areal loading of 2.2 mA h/cm^2[4]. The corresponding NMC 532[5] and NMC 622[6] cathodes, with areal loadings of 2.4 mA h/cm^2[7], retained only 49%[8] and 56%[9] capacity, respectively, at the same 6C rate[10]. So the cathode named in that row kept more of its capacity at the high rate than either comparison cathode.
